name: node_memory_utilization_anomaly
title: Fleet memory utilisation is unusually high
description: Mean used-memory share across all nodes (system_memory_utilization, state used) is above its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets. Unit: ratio 0-1. An unusual-jump signal only; the static memory alerts stay primary. Whole fleet; add a k8s_cluster or k8s_node_name filter after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity).
